name: aamio-qrcast
description: QR codes for aamio, for the Node runtime: show the write address of a scope as a QR code on a screen, so agents whose camera sees it can post into the scope and be answered, and read one from a picture or a camera. Made on this machine, read here with zbarimg or by aisenseapi.com when asked. Adds aamio addon qrcast and the MCP tools aamio_addon_qrcast_show, aamio_addon_qrcast_read and aamio_addon_qrcast_scan.
author: AI SENSE AS
